summary: Fermi Inc. filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026 announcing that its indirect wholly owned subsidiaries, Fermi Turbine Warehouse LLC (Borrower) and Firebird Equipment Holdco LLC, entered into a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement dated February 10, 2026, with MUFG Bank as administrative agent and lender. The amendment removes the covenant requiring a lease or offtake arrangement for 400 MW at Project Matador by November 10, 2026, and eliminates related accelerated amortization, avoiding roughly $22M, $19M and $15M of potential principal payments in 4Q26, 1Q27 and 2Q27; $25M of amendment fees were paid. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch the underlying Matador leasing progress.
